title: Mounted Members of the Korean Constabulary in Jeju-Do, Korea
partOf: NARA › RG 342 › Photographs of Activities, Facilities, and Personnel
summary: Original caption: CHEJU-DO MOUNTIES - The Korean constabulary, either mounted or afoot, have proved their efficiency and reliability through working with the U. S. Military Government. These mounted police are stationed at Cheju-do, Korea, as evidenced by the Korean woman carrying her burden by shoulder straps.
